content.short: CREW³ is a one-stop tool for onboarding and incentivizing DAO contributors.
content.description: Crew³ is an onboarding tool for DAOs that turns newcomers into active contributors. It records and surfaces member activities, linking rewards to demonstrated impact to create a clear path from participation to recognition. The platform’s automation handles essential DAO workflows, including whitelisting new members and running contests, helping communities streamline administration and scale engagement with fairness and accountability.
content.meta: CREW³ provides crew - a one-stop tool for onboarding and incentivization in DAOs. Discover CREW³ and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
